assessments.reasoning: Section 2.1 of the retained XML 1.0 Fifth Edition Recommendation requires a well-formed document to match a production with one document-level element. Its root definition also requires that the entire root lie outside the content of every other element.

challenge.method: Test whether nesting, a prolog, trailing miscellaneous material, or a second sibling element permits multiple roots.
challenge.results: Nested elements have parents. The grammar allows material around the document element but provides no position for a second sibling element. The requirement concerns whole documents.

limitations: Leading or trailing prolog and miscellaneous material permitted by the document grammar do not count as root elements.
The condition attaches to a well-formed XML document in the named edition. The claim concerns the document element, regardless of DTD validity.
